General Remark

The land sold during the year amounted to 40,720 41 acres which realized $45,134.98. The quantity of surrendered
land in the hands of the department was approximately 433,249 acres. The principal outstanding, on account of Indian
Lands sold, amounted to $152,560.87, a considerable portion of which has not yet become due.
